name: Llorac (Spain)
description: Dark green field charged at the centre with a yellow couped laurel tree.
history: The official flag of Llorac is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, dark green, with the yellow couped laurel of the arms, 3/4 of the height and 11/30 of the length of the cloth, at the centre; approved on 26 April 2013 and published in the DOGC on 15 May 2013.
